mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 37 degrees and a first quarter moon overhead.
City officials have announced a public information meeting on December 8 at the Senior Center regarding upcoming paving and bridge replacement projects on the Military Ridge State Trail.
There is plenty to do around town, including trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga classes scheduled for tomorrow.
In police news, on November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, which led to an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Turtle. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit to enjoy this delicious custard.
